content:
A reliable Chinese leaker recently posted schematics that claim to show the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro.

The images suggest the new A20 Pro chip may come with seven GPU cores — one more than the previous generation — along with a faster memory interface…

The images posted by Weibo user "Fried White Rice" (炒飯) are not of the A20 Pro chip itself, but rather diagrams showing where the chip will be soldered onto the underlying circuit board. From these, they inferred the performance and architecture of the new chip, drawing two main conclusions about likely improvements.

First, the images show six CPU cores in the same setup as last year: two high-performance cores plus four efficiency cores. However, the efficiency cores appear to have increased cache memory.

Because soldering diagrams offer limited information, it is difficult to determine the GPU core count from them — six, seven and eight are all plausible. That said, they consider seven cores to be the most likely.

Fixed Focus Digital previously noted that the A20 Pro chip will be 18% faster than its predecessor, while delivering a 30% improvement in power efficiency.

9to5Mac's take

This Weibo account does have a track record of credibility, but this kind of indirect inference is very tricky. While the conclusions drawn do make sense, they should be taken only as informed speculation, not as proven fact.
